answer: Resist sybils with time-locked stake bonds tied to a public work ledger. Like water carving a karst cave, trust forms only through slow, recorded flow: each agent locks a bond at the economy inlet, and the lock loosens one epoch at a time as peers attest real completed tasks, each attestation a verse in a sonnet of verified history. Quitting early burns the bond. An attacker spawning ten thousand fake identities pays ten thousand bonds plus the waiting time, and the burns drain the profit from any bot swarm. One wallet, one bonded history: cheap to join, ruinous to fake.
